recentItems.title: Yemen’s besieged city of Taiz faces food shortages as fighting escalates
recentItems.description:
The conflict between Yemen's government and the Ansar Allah Houthis has intensified near Taiz.
The siege by the Houthis is worsening a humanitarian crisis, and there are concerns the 800,000 people trapped there could run out of food.

Al Jazeera correspondent Hadeel al-Yamani reports from Taiz, Yemen.

recentItems.title: Uncovering a Criminal Network On the Early Internet | True Crime Reports
recentItems.description:
In the early days of the internet, police uncover one of the largest and most sophisticated paedophile networks of its time, sparking a global manhunt. As investigators sift through thousands of messages, one crucial piece of evidence sets off one of the biggest international arrest operations ever seen. How did police bring down the internet’s first global criminal network?

The illustrations in this video have been created by artists aided by AI-powered software.

recentItems.title: Israeli attacks kill two Palestinians in Gaza as ceasefire violations continue
recentItems.description:
At least two Palestinians have been killed in the latest Israeli attacks in Gaza, as Israeli forces continue near-daily strikes despite the ceasefire.

The two Palestinians died in hospital after being seriously wounded in a strike in Al-Mawasi, southern Gaza. Israeli forces also opened fire from military vehicles in several areas and carried out new demolitions in northern Gaza. The attacks came a day after four other Palestinians were killed across the Strip.

Israel continues to restrict the entry of essential supplies, including shelter materials, heavy machinery and medical equipment. With winter rains flooding tents and damaging homes, many Palestinians remain exposed to cold and severe weather.

Al Jazeera’s Tareq Abu Azzoum reports from Gaza City.
